scripts.stage: rm -rf .site && rsync -a --exclude .nvmrc --exclude .git --exclude .claude --exclude .vscode --exclude .wrangler --exclude .site --exclude node_modules --exclude package.json --exclude package-lock.json --exclude .gitignore --exclude CNAME ./ .site/
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run stage && wrangler pages deploy .site --project-name=rharricharan-portfolio --branch=$(git branch --show-current)
scripts.deploy: npm run stage && wrangler pages deploy .site --project-name=rharricharan-portfolio --branch=main
